title: Artificial Intelligence Curriculum Guidelines for Primary and Secondary Schools (ECNU journal)
notes: ECNU journal (peer-reviewed), 2023-03-01, Jiang Bo et al. (Institute of AI Education ECNU + Shanghai AI Lab). Jointly developed AI Curriculum Guidelines for primary/secondary schools. 6 parts: course nature, core competency/objectives, structure, content/requirements, evaluation standards, implementation. Modules: basic concepts (data/algorithm/compute), characteristics, history, industry apps, key domain tech (NLP/CV/voice/biometric/VR-AR/HMI), perception/data mgmt, datasets/bias, ML (unsup/sup/RL, regression/classification/clustering/deep learning), HW/SW platforms (CPU/GPU/TPU, PaddlePaddle/PyTorch/TensorFlow), ethics, social impact. 4 core competencies per stage: intelligence awareness/thinking/application-creation/social responsibility.
